summary: Frontend-only smoke test for 3 items (iteration_87 continuation). All 3 UI flows verified working; no console/page errors observed.

verified_flows.flow: Admin > Master Data & Audit > Pelanggan > Impor/Ekspor CSV
verified_flows.steps: Login admin@kainnusantara.id (ent_ksc); ?view=admin -> Master Data & Audit -> Pelanggan tab -> clicked 'Impor / Ekspor CSV' toggle (data-testid=admin-toggle-import-export).
verified_flows.result: PASS. Hint element data-testid='admin-import-customer-columns' visible and lists required columns: name (wajib), sales_email/sales_name (wajib untuk baru), code (opsional), pic_name, phone, email, city, address, type, npwp. Uploaded CSV with a single row 'TEST_UI_A' missing sales columns; clicked Pratinjau (dry-run) -> preview reported 0 dibuat, 0 diperbarui, 1 galat: 'Baris 2: sales penanggung jawab wajib (kolom sales_email atau sales_name)'. No customer created (dry-run) -> no cleanup needed.

verified_flows.steps: Seeded roll via API POST /api/inventory/initial-stock (product_id=prod_batik_mega, warehouse_id=wh_bandung, roll_no=TESTUI-NOCOST-1, quantity=10, unit=yard, NO unit_cost) as admin with X-Entity-Id=ent_ksc. Opened ?view=operations&entity=ent_ksc -> Stok tab -> clicked 'Tambah Stok' (data-testid=add-stock-button) to open modal containing InitialStockForm -> OpeningCostAlert.
verified_flows.result: PASS. data-testid='opening-cost-alert' visible; clicked 'opening-cost-toggle', filled 'opening-cost-input-roll_ddcb80b309ef' with 15000, clicked 'opening-cost-save-roll_ddcb80b309ef'. Alert disappeared (was only one) confirming PATCH succeeded (backend returned 200; msg 'HPP tersimpan.' path exercised, alert unmounted because data.total became 0). Cleanup performed: deleted inventory_roll, related movement, and lot from Mongo.

verified_flows.flow: GRN list screen loads (grn-mko-partial-toggle code-review only)
verified_flows.result: PASS. Screen renders with data-testid='grn-list' container and data-testid='grn-list-empty' (Belum ada kedatangan). No pageerror events, no console errors. grn-mko-partial-toggle is only rendered inside GrnReconPanel when GRN status='reconcile' with mko_step lines; no GRNs currently in DB. Code review of frontend/src/features/wms/grn/GrnReconPanel.jsx confirms toggle is conditionally rendered and wired to backend flag as documented.

critical_code_review_comments: OpeningCostAlert row projection in backend/routers/inventory.py::rolls_without_cost projects fields 'sku'/'product_name'/'quantity' which are not top-level roll fields (roll uses 'length_initial' for qty and 'product_id'; sku/product_name may be present via roll_domain_snapshot but 'quantity' is not). In our test the row displayed only roll_no + unit, missing sku/product/quantity. Consider projecting 'length_initial' as quantity and joining/using snapshot fields for display. Non-blocking cosmetic issue.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created inventory_roll roll_ddcb80b309ef (roll_no=TESTUI-NOCOST-1) via /api/inventory/initial-stock; fully cleaned up after test (roll+movement+lot deleted from Mongo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 UI features from review request verified. No new GRN created (heavy). If future test needs to exercise grn-mko-partial-toggle live, seed a GRN with status='reconcile' and mko_step lines then navigate to GRN detail 'recon' tab.
